summary: The Vault page now has a Platforms section for Instagram, the Facebook Page, YouTube Shorts and TikTok: whether each is connected, what goes there, and how the account is doing on each. The specialist reads them every few hours, read only.
frontend: Platforms on the Vault page: a card for each platform with Connected, Not connected or Not set up, a sentence on what it posts there (YouTube says it waits for Google's audit; TikTok says what setting it up takes), and its numbers: followers, posts, Reel views and reach, likes, comments and new followers over the last 7 or 28 days, with a link to the account.
other: New command platforms (social.yml) reads them now; the morning run and each Reel slot run read them again when they're over 3 hours old. Nothing is posted or changed.
Hitta can answer how each platform is doing.
YouTube's channel read now includes total views.
